rationale: The first reply pushed a door lock replacement, and the second recommended a specific part number and a top-panel DIY removal even though the duvet-only symptom pointed to an overfilled drum. The final turn corrected course, saying it was the duvet and not the lock, but it was cut off and still blamed weight and bulk. It never advised reducing the load, never said the king-size duvet is probably over the machine's capacity, and never suggested a launderette or checking the manual. It also never asked what was in the drum or whether anything was caught in the seal, though it did suggest checking the gasket. Adding towels to a duvet load would worsen overfilling. The units were mixed (US dollars and lbs) and some details were invented, such as the wet weight of the duvet.</br>
